description.value: Fish Lake Cabin is a fee-based backcountry wilderness hut situated within Top of the World Provincial Park in BC's Kootenay region. It offers remote overnight shelter for adventurers accessing the park's high-elevation terrain. Cyclists considering a stop here should plan for full self-sufficiency, as it is a primitive backcountry structure managed by BC Parks.
